in_marathi.name: Manohar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Mind or Desire
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manohar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manohar is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'manas' which means mind or desire. The name is associated with the Hindu god Manavaraha or Manasa, who is believed to control the mind, emotions, and desires. Manohar is a powerful name that evokes a sense of inner strength, wisdom, and self-control.
